description: The bar chart illustrates "Evaluation Based on Different Tasks," representing accuracy across two evaluation categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "MCQ Eval" and "Generation Eval". The vertical axis represents "Accuracy" on a linear scale, with a visible range from 0.0 to above 0.6 and tick marks at intervals of 0.2, though the highest tick label is obscured by a grey rectangle. For each category, the chart displays a grouped arrangement consisting of a single bar on the left and a stacked bar on the right. According to the legend, the single solid orange bar represents "Base". The stacked bar consists of a light orange bottom segment representing "RMU" and a pale yellow top segment representing "RMU with Enhanced GCG". All bars feature black outlines and are annotated with exact numerical values. In the "MCQ Eval" category, the Base bar is the tallest in the chart at 0.644, while the adjacent stacked bar reaches a total height of 0.539, with its bottom RMU component annotated as 0.299. In the "Generation Eval" category, the Base bar has a value of 0.597, and the stacked bar reaches a total height of 0.263, with its bottom RMU component being the shortest individual segment at 0.106. The categories are not sorted in a specific order, and visual emphasis is provided by the numerical annotations placed above the single bars and total stacks, as well as inside the bottom segments of the stacked bars.
